faq.q: What is the Capo Pistol in GTA 6?
faq.a: A pistol made by an in-game manufacturer called Capo. IGN reported seeing it in one of the Grand Theft Auto VI screenshots and described it as one of several 9mm types shown so far.

faq.q: Is the Capo Pistol the Heavy Pistol from GTA 5?
faq.a: No such link has been established. IGN compared the look of the two, but a visual comparison by an outlet is not a statement that the older weapon returns, and this site does not record it as one.

faq.q: Who makes the Capo Pistol in GTA 6?
faq.a: Capo, which IGN gave as the manufacturer. Grand Theft Auto weapons carry invented brand names like this one, so the manufacturer is part of the weapon name rather than a real company.

faq.q: What caliber is the Capo Pistol?
faq.a: IGN described it as a 9mm and said several 9mm pistols have been shown so far. Nothing further about ammunition or magazine size has been published by Rockstar.

faq.q: How do players get the Capo Pistol in GTA 6?
faq.a: No price, shop or unlock method has been published. The full in-game name, the damage and the magazine size are unverified too, because the game has not released.

notKnown: Whether it is related to the Heavy Pistol from earlier games
howWeKnow: The Capo Pistol comes from IGN's Grand Theft Auto VI weapons list, read on 2 September 2026, where it was described from a single Rockstar screenshot. One screenshot and one outlet is thin evidence, so the entry sits at medium confidence and stays marked as a press report.
